verses.en: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?
verses.sm: pe aoga i ni a le peritome?

verses.en: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.
verses.sm: E tele lava i mea uma; a e muamua lenei, ona ua tuuina atu ia te i latou o afioga a le Atua.

verses.en: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?
verses.sm: A faapefea? afai ua le faamaoni nisi, pe faaleaogaina ea le faamaoni O le Atua i lo latou le faamaoni?

verses.en: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.
verses.sm: Ana ne“ faapea; ia tuu le faamaoni i le Atua, a o le pepelo i tagata uma lava; pei ona tusia, Ina ia ta‘uamiotonuina oe i au afioga, ma ia e malo pe a faamasinoina oe.

verses.en: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
verses.sm: A e afai e faaalitinoina le amiotonu a le Atua i la tatou amioletonu, se a ea sa tatou upu e fai? Ua amioletonu ea le Atua, O le na te tuuina mai le toasa? (O upu a tagata ou te fai atu ai nei.)

verses.en: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
verses.sm: Aua neʻi faapea; a faapea, pe faapefea ona faamasinoina le lalolagi e le Atua?

verses.en: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
verses.sm: Aua a faateleina le faamaoni o le Atua e tupu ai lona viiga ona o loʻu pepelo, e faamasinoina aʻu i se a, pei o se ua agasala?

verses.en: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
verses.sm: A e le seʻi faapea ea, (pei ona upuleagaina i matou, pei ona fai ane foi e nisi, ua faapea la matou upu,) la tatou fai mea leaga, ina ia tupu ai mea lelei? E tusa ai la latou sala.

verses.en: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
verses.sm: O lenei, pe faapefea? ua matou silisili ea? E leai lava; auá ua uma ona molia e i tatou o Iutaia atoa ma Eleni, o loo nofo sala i latou uma lava;

verses.en: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
verses.sm: faapei ona tusia, E leai sé amiotonu, e leai lava se tasi,

verses.en: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.
verses.sm: e leai se na te lagona, e leai sé saili i le Atua.

verses.en: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.sm: Ua latou o ese uma lava, ua leaga faatasi i latou, e leai se ua amio lelei, ua leai lava se tasi.

verses.en: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
verses.sm: Ua se tuugamau ua faamaga o latou aau, ua ‘ole‘ole o latou laulaufaiva, o î o latou laugutu le mea oona o le asipi.1

verses.en: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
verses.sm: Ua tumu o latou gutu i le fetuu ma le upu faafiufiu.

verses.en: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
verses.sm: Ua tele vavave o latou vae e sasaa ai le toto.

verses.en: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
verses.sm: O 1 o latou ala le olopalaina ma le puapuagatia;

verses.en: And the way of peace have they not known:
verses.sm: ua latou le iloa foi le ala o le manuia.

verses.en: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
verses.sm: E leai lava so latou mataʻu ile Atua.

verses.en: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
verses.sm: O lenei, ua tatou iloa, o mea uma ua fai mai e le tulafono, ua fai mai lava i e ua i ai le tulafono, ina ia punitia ai gutu uma lava, ma ia nofo sala le lalolagi uma i luma o le Atua.

verses.en: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
verses.sm: Aua e le tatuamiotonuina se tagata e toatasi i ona luma i galuega o le tulafono; auá o le tulafono e iloa lelei ai le agasala.

verses.en: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
verses.sm: A o lenei, ua faaalia mai le amiotonu a le Atua, e le o iai le tulafono, ua molimau i ai e le tulafono atoa ma le au perofeta;

verses.en: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
verses.sm: 0 le amiotonu lea a le Atua i le faatuatua ia Iesu Keriso, e oo i tagata uma, mo tagata uma foi o e faatuatua; auā e le eseese lava.

verses.en: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
verses.sm: Auā ua agasala tagata uma lava, ma ua le oo i le mamalu o le Atua;

verses.en: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
verses.sm: ua ta'uamiotonuina fua i lona alofa tunoa i le togiola e a Keriso Iesu,

verses.en: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
verses.sm: o le ua tuuina mai i luma e le Atua, o le taulaga mo agasala i lona toto, e maua i le faatuatua; ina ia faaalitinoina mai lana amiotonu i le le tauia o agasəla ua mavae, i le faapalepale o le Atua;

verses.en: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
verses.sm: ina ia faaalitinoina mai foi lana amiotonu i ona po nei, ina ia iloa ai o ia o lē amiotonu, ma ua ta'uamiotonuina e ia le ua faatuatua ia Iesu.

verses.en: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
verses.sm: O lenei, o ifea le mitamita? Ua vaoia. I se fea tulafono? O le tulafono i galuega ea? E leai, a o le tulafono i le faatuatua.

verses.en: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
verses.sm: O lenei, ua tatou taofi, e ta‘uamiotonuina le tagata i le faatuatua, e le o i ai galuega o le tulafono.

verses.en: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
verses.sm: Po o le Atua ea o le Atua na o Iutaia? E le atoa ea foi ma nuu ese? Ioe, atoa foi ma nuu ese.

verses.en: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
verses.sm: Auā foi o le Atua e tasi lava na te ta‘uamiotonuina i le faatuatua le ua peritomeina, atoa ma le ua le peritomeina, ua i ai le faatuatua.

verses.en: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
verses.sm: O lenei, e faaleaoga ea e i tatou le tulafono i le faatuatua?
